_comment: Curated seed list -- the documented way to add a project the automated
relevance rules miss. Add owner/repo here instead of editing a README: the
README is regenerated on every tick and any manual edit to it is lost.
A seeded repository bypasses the relevance filter and the star floor, but it
does NOT bypass evidence grading. A human saying 'include this' is not the
same as verifying what the project does, so a seed still lands at
'inferred' unless the collector finds independent code-level evidence.
